_meta.title: Sucker Rod Reference Data
_meta.description: Edit this file to add/remove rod grades or sizes — any field you add to a size entry shows up as a column on the Rods page automatically. Standard fields: size (nominal, inches), weight_lb_ft (weight per foot, includes coupling), max_pull_lbf (maximum recommended weight indicator pull to unseat a stuck pump - 90% of minimum yield strength, straight steady pull, NOT a shock load). Add field names to hidden_fields below to hide a column without deleting the data. The top-level 'kbars' array holds K-Bar/sinker bar weight-per-ft by size, used by the Unset DH Pump calculator's K-Bar rows (no grade/tension, weight only). Each grade may optionally have an 'image' field (e.g. 'images/rod-d78.png', relative to index.html) shown above that grade's table; missing/incorrect image paths just stay hidden, no broken-image icon. The top-level 'extra_tabs' array adds extra tab buttons alongside the grade tabs for free-form content that isn't a grade table — each tab has a 'label' and a 'sections' array using the same block types (text/kv/table/list/image) documented in _template.json.
_meta.source: Norris (ChampionX) Maximum Recommended Weight Indicator Pull table; weights per API 11B sucker rod dimensions
